profile.historical_note: Snapshot checked on 2026-11-05; not a point-in-time legal opinion for every trade. Review corporate reorganizations and ticker changes before historical attribution.
profile.notes: Primary-source extraction. Incorporation, operating exposure and security structure are separate fields. The office country is not substituted for operating country.
profile.operations_basis: Second-pass review of the cited annual report operating and properties disclosures. The report explicitly identifies Adelaide as the principal and main operating office, distinguished from the registered address in Melbourne. This classifies the disclosed operating-management base, not all group exposure. This is not a claim of exclusive legal exposure.
profile.security_basis: The registered-security cover table identifies common or ordinary shares, rather than depositary shares.
profile.vie_basis: No conclusive issuer-specific VIE statement established. Absence of a match is not proof that no VIE exists.
